turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on numbers and time words?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you one first.
A: Is the film at six? B: No, at seven.
Step 1: A says six. Step 2: B says No, so six is wrong. Step 3: B gives a new time, seven. So the film is at seven.
The rule: when someone says no and gives a new time, the new time is the final time.
Right: A: Lunch at one? B: No, at two. Lunch is at two. Wrong: Lunch is at one.
Now you. Write the time.
What time is the lesson?
